orders.fixedOffer: The accepted offer remains unchanged. Only order and project details are saved here.
orders.cancelConfirm: Cancel order {{number}}? The offer stays locked and documents are retained.
orders.acceptedHint: Accepted offers can no longer be changed.
orders.selectOffer: Select an offer for the order

confirmation.title: Order confirmation
confirmation.hint: The confirmation number is assigned once and cannot be changed afterwards. Net, VAT and gross are calculated from the accepted offer.
confirmation.deleteBlockedHint: Delete the document first to be able to delete the confirmation.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.hint: The invoice number is assigned once and cannot be changed afterwards. Line items, net, VAT and gross come from the order.
invoice.deleteBlockedHint: Delete the document first to be able to delete the invoice.

purchase.title: Purchase prices (order to the supplier)
purchase.hint: Per user and month, net. Prefilled with the sales price. Flat rates and discounts of the offer stay with the customer.
purchase.fallback: Purchase prices not recorded yet (equal to the sales price).

modal.title: Create order
modal.pickHint: Pick the offer the customer accepted.
modal.emptyHint: Search and click on the left. You will then see positions, amount and validity here and enter the purchase prices.

vat.preview: Net {{net}} + {{rate}} % VAT ({{vat}}) = gross {{gross}}. The rate is stored with the document and fixed afterwards.
